EXTENSION_GUIDES.ADD_ENVIRONMENT: Need another environment? Return to Manage Instances and select Add Cloud Instance.
EXTENSION_GUIDES.ALTERNATIVE_SUBTITLE: Configure the Blocks OS V4 instance with JSON or enter the same values manually.
EXTENSION_GUIDES.CURL_DESCRIPTION: Run this command in your terminal using your localization domain. In the response, find BLOCKS_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL and BLOCKS_X_BLOCKS_KEY under the runtime environment configuration. Use those values for either setup method above.
EXTENSION_GUIDES.CURL_TITLE: Get the runtime configuration with curl
EXTENSION_GUIDES.EDIT_DESCRIPTION: Use the pencil button to update a saved instance configuration.
EXTENSION_GUIDES.JSON_DESCRIPTION: Paste the complete configuration into the extension instead of entering each value separately.
EXTENSION_GUIDES.JSON_STEP_1: In the extension, enter an instance name and select V4 – Blocks OS.
EXTENSION_GUIDES.JSON_STEP_3: Copy the configuration below and paste it into Blocks OS Configuration JSON.
EXTENSION_GUIDES.KEY_MODE_DESCRIPTION: Copy the prompt below into your AI coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, etc.) to automatically configure Key Mode and Value Mode support in your codebase. This instruction provides your AI agent with the extension's event contract and framework-specific event listener implementations.
EXTENSION_GUIDES.MANUAL_DESCRIPTION: Select Manual under Setup Method, then copy the API Base URL and X-Blocks-Key into their matching fields.
EXTENSION_GUIDES.REMOVE_DESCRIPTION: Use the trash button to remove an instance you no longer need.
EXTENSION_GUIDES.SETUP_SUBTITLE: Follow these steps from the extension sign-in screen.
EXTENSION_GUIDES.SUBTITLE: Connect SELISE Blocks Assistant to a Blocks OS instance.
EXTENSION_GUIDES.TITLE: Extension Guides
EXTENSION_GUIDE_STEPS.STEP_1_DESCRIPTION: Install SELISE Blocks Assistant from the <store>Chrome Web Store<icon/></store>, then open it to reach the sign-in screen.
EXTENSION_GUIDE_STEPS.STEP_2_DESCRIPTION: On the sign-in screen, select the Manage instances button to the right of the Choose Instance list.
EXTENSION_GUIDE_STEPS.STEP_2_IMAGE_ALT: SELISE Blocks sign-in screen highlighting the Manage instances button
EXTENSION_GUIDE_STEPS.STEP_3_DESCRIPTION: Select + Add Cloud Instance. You can save up to 10 instances and return here later to edit or remove them.
EXTENSION_GUIDE_STEPS.STEP_3_IMAGE_ALT: Manage Instances screen showing the Add Cloud Instance button
EXTENSION_GUIDE_STEPS.STEP_4_DESCRIPTION: Give the instance a recognizable name and select its microservice version(i.e. V4 - Blocks OS). Use the manual setup to enter the API Base URL and X-Blocks-Key, or select the JSON setup method and paste the instance configuration from below.
EXTENSION_GUIDE_STEPS.STEP_4_IMAGE_1_ALT: Manual setup form with the instance name, version, API URL, and X-Blocks-Key fields
EXTENSION_GUIDE_STEPS.STEP_4_IMAGE_2_ALT: JSON setup form for adding a Blocks OS V4 instance configuration
EXTENSION_GUIDE_STEPS.STEP_5_DESCRIPTION: Select Save, return to the sign-in screen, and choose the new instance from the Choose Instance list. The selected instance is marked as active.
EXTENSION_GUIDE_STEPS.STEP_5_IMAGE_ALT: Manage Instances screen showing saved Blocks Cloud and Blocks OS instances
EXTENSION_GUIDE_STEPS.STEP_6_DESCRIPTION: Select the Blocks OS instance from the Choose Instance list, then click Sign in with Blocks OS. You can now use the extension with that instance.
EXTENSION_GUIDE_STEPS.STEP_6_IMAGE_1_ALT: SELISE Blocks sign-in screen with the instance selector open
EXTENSION_GUIDE_STEPS.STEP_6_IMAGE_2_ALT: SELISE Blocks sign-in screen with a Blocks OS instance selected

WORDPRESS_PLUGIN_GUIDE.SUBTITLE: Connect your WordPress site to Blocks Localization from Integrations in Blocks OS.
WORDPRESS_PLUGIN_GUIDE.TITLE: WordPress Plugin Guide
WORDPRESS_PLUGIN_GUIDE_STEPS.STEP_1_DESC: In Blocks OS, create a new role called wp-user and assign the necessary permissions for the Blocks Localization WordPress plugin to function correctly. Go to Roles management
WORDPRESS_PLUGIN_GUIDE_STEPS.STEP_2_DESC: Create client credentials in Blocks OS and assign the wp-user role to it. This Client ID and Client Secret will be used to authenticate your WordPress instance. Go to Create Credentials
WORDPRESS_PLUGIN_GUIDE_STEPS.STEP_3_BLOC: X-Blocks-Key - Found in your Blocks Localization project settings
WORDPRESS_PLUGIN_GUIDE_STEPS.STEP_3_CLIE: Client Id - From the client credentials you created in Blocks OS
Client Secret - From the client credentials you created in Blocks OS
WORDPRESS_PLUGIN_GUIDE_STEPS.STEP_3_INTR: To integrate Blocks Localization with WordPress, you need the following credentials:
WORDPRESS_PLUGIN_GUIDE_STEPS.STEP_3_ORIG: Origin - The Blocks Localization application origin shown in Setup Status
